exchanges: evening!
Evening, hope your day went well.
my cousin rowan is moving to Antwerp for a job and im so jealous
That sounds like an amazing adventure.
european cafes, bikes everywhere, the dream
It does sound pretty idyllic.
meanwhile im stuck writing a lab report for oceanography
Lab reports are a slog, but you'll get through it.
its about plankton. so much plankton
Plankton deserve their moment too.
my partner brought home day-old bread from Lindqvist where she works, best perk ever
Free bread is a top-tier perk.
we ate most of a loaf standing in the kitchen
That's the only correct way to eat fresh bread.
dara slipped on ice and got a concussion, shes ok but has to rest
I'm glad she's okay, rest is important.
no screens for her which she says is torture
That's a tough rule to follow these days.
my dog Parsnip ate a sock today, again
Hopefully it passes without any trouble.
vet says hell be fine, just gross
Gross but fine is the best outcome.
grandpa pulled out his harmonica at lunch and played for the whole restaurant
That must have been a fun surprise for everyone.
some people clapped, some looked mortified
Sounds like a memorable lunch either way.
my boss rolled up in a brand new Volvo today and wouldnt stop talking about it
New car excitement is hard to contain.
im just happy i dont have car payments
That's a nice freedom to have.
rowan next door told me hes moving to Kelowna, which is wild because my cousin is also a rowan and also moving
That's quite the coincidence.
so many rowans moving at once
It's a big season for Rowans.
watching Frasier reruns to procrastinate
That's a cozy way to avoid work.
the lab report is not writing itself
Sadly, they never do.
dara's daughter Juniper is staying with us while dara recovers

the library on campus at Halverton has a quiet room so i might go hide there tomorrow
A quiet room sounds perfect for getting it done.
partner and i are getting dinner first
Enjoy dinner together.
Maplewood, our favourite diner, they have the best pancakes

ok later!
See you later!
